|errata_history=Versions of [[Anakin's Lightsaber (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. Found while comparing the Committee's 2008 re-issue of the sheet with the January 2007 sheet (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visibly different printing is a version).
* '''Original''' (this page): the release sheet “Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates” (Players Committee, “Official text as of January 9, 2007”; PDF dated 10 January 2007; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007), page 3, slip 1 ([[:File:OVS12-01-Anakin_s_Lightsaber-slip-2007-01-09.png]]), in the Committee's Remaster template; game text as above.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Anakin's Lightsaber (V) (Virtual Set 12) (Errata)]]): the re-issued sheet (PDF dated 12 August 2008; headed “Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 20 February 2009), page 3, slip 1 ([[:File:OVS12-01-Anakin_s_Lightsaber-slip-2008-08-12.png]]). '''What changed:''' the words and numbers are unchanged; the credit line, printed in January 2007 sideways in the slip's side margins (“Original concept by Peter Nordstrom” / “Alderaan Regional 2005”), now runs along the bottom of the text box as one line: “Original concept by Alderaan Regionals 2005 Peter Nordstrom”. The second part also changed from “Alderaan Regional 2005” to “Alderaan Regionals 2005”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
